title: Truly Lightweight
description: A really lightweight modpack, that is really optimized as well
body:
Truly lightweight focuses on being really lightweight, for example latest version of modpack has only 11 mods, but don't underestimate the performance of the modpack! it includes the basic optimization mods and is a great modpack that you can mod

Truly lightweight also includes iris shaders so that you can add your favourite shader
in 1 click or just not use one at all!
and the modpack has mod menu preinstalled so you can configure mods easily

<details>
<summary>Mods Included</summary>

Sodium
> https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium
>
> Performance mod that boosts performance A LOT!

ScalableLux
> https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux
> 
> Mod based on Starlight that improves the performance of light updates

Model Gap Fix
> https://modrinth.com/mod/modelfix
> 
> Fixes gaps at the edges of models

Lithium
> https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium
> 
> General-purpose optimization mod

FerriteCore
> https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core
> 
> Reduces the memory usage of Minecraft

Entity Culling
> https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling
> 
> Hides entities and block entities that are not visible

Concurrent Chunk Management
> https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric
> 
> Designed to improve the chunk performance of Minecraft

Modpack also includes other mods like mod menu and iris shaders


</details>
